mechanism: Both drugs increase gastrointestinal ulceration and bleeding risk; betamethasone enhances NSAID-induced GI toxicity and increases fluid retention, while diclofenac reduces renal function compounding corticosteroid-induced hypertension and electrolyte imbalances.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective doses for shortest duration, add gastroprotection (PPI), monitor blood pressure, electrolytes, and renal function regularly.
